methods.label: Total probability
methods.explanation: For each channel, multiply its selection probability by its passage rate. This gives \((1/2)(1)=1/2\), \((1/3)(1/2)=1/6\), and \((1/6)(0)=0\). The channel choices are disjoint and exhaustive, so the overall probability is \(1/2+1/6+0=2/3\).
methods.levelReason: A three-case total-probability calculation, including conditional rates 0 and 1, fits the stated high-school elective scope.
